method.acoustic: For paired positive clips measure full-clip and truth-window SI-SDR with the known early-room foreground after inference input construction. The reference is used only for diagnostics, without influencing output, points, or eligibility.
method.decisions: Add the strongest admitted WPE window above its fitted point to the retained frozen mono result. Compare exact timestamps on two windows and publisher truth at overlap 0.30 and half-edit coverage. Require at least two added reader groups from two families across full-room and noisy stages, no more than one extra genuine group and no background-only additions. Dry and early controls must also have no added genuine groups. Repeated levels of the same source count once.
method.prediction: Estimate late energy from ten previous stereo frames starting three hops (24 ms) back. Iterate three variance-normalized least-squares updates, using a five-frame mean power estimate with a one-percent per-bin floor and 0.001 diagonal loading relative to covariance mean diagonal. Return the residual stereo mean in its original clock. Decline invalid, clipped and near-empty outputs.
method.roles: Use the exact frozen Aachen room-stress waveform groups. Prior-exposed samples support comparison only. Before new assessment inference fit one candidate point at the strict maximum over eight separate genuine readers and all full-room and noisy stages. Also report use at the original mono point as a diagnostic. Test dry and early stages as negative processing controls and the six background-only excerpts in the assessment role.
method.transform: 512-sample square-root periodic Hann, 128-sample hop, symmetric zero padding and weighted overlap-add at the unchanged 16 kHz clock. Use both channels to predict both current spectra.
